# Viewer dependencies

- `model-viewer.min.js`: Google's [model-viewer](https://github.com/google/model-viewer), distributed under Apache-2.0. The bundled dependency license notices are retained in the JavaScript; see `model-viewer-LICENSE`.
- `meshopt_decoder.js`: [meshoptimizer v1.3](https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer/tree/v1.3), distributed under MIT; see `meshoptimizer-LICENSE.md`.

Both scripts are served locally. Opening a reconstruction does not require an external viewer service or CDN.
